CheckTitle: Check if RDS instances storage is encrypted
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that RDS DB instance storage is encrypted at rest.
Risk: Unencrypted database storage, snapshots and replicas expose sensitive data if storage or backups are accessed.

Recommendation.Text: Create an encrypted snapshot copy and restore it into a new encrypted instance; enable encryption for all new instances.
